title: Choose the particle
instructions: Write the missing particle (one or two words).

items.q: We have to set ______ early tomorrow to avoid the traffic.
I can't figure ______ how this machine works.
The meeting has been called ______ because the manager is ill.
We've run ______ of milk - can you buy some?
Please carry ______ with your work while I'm away.
Could you go ______ the report once more before we send it?
The company has cut ______ on travel expenses.
She came ______ with a brilliant solution in five minutes.
I refuse to put up ______ this noise any longer.
He finally gave ______ and admitted he was wrong.
Don't forget to factor ______ the cost of transport.
After years of rivalry, the larger firm took ______ its competitor.
The talks broke ______ after the two sides failed to agree.
Several hundred workers were laid ______ last year.
His story didn't add ______; the police knew he was lying.

title: Formal verb -> phrasal verb
instructions: Replace the verb in brackets with a phrasal verb in the correct form.

items.q: The event was ______ until next month. (postponed)
We need to ______ our spending. (reduce)
She ______ his behaviour for years. (tolerated)
I'll ______ the matter and call you back. (investigate)
A problem ______ during testing. (arose)
He really ______ his father - same smile, same temper. (resembles)
The plane ______ on time. (departed)
We must ______ unnecessary paperwork. (eliminate)
It took me two weeks to ______ the flu. (recover from)
They ______ the offer because the salary was too low. (rejected)
Please don't ______ your dreams. (abandon)
The smoke ______ the fire alarm. (activated)
We are ______ our savings much faster than expected. (depleting)
I only ______ the truth years later. (discovered)
Let's ______ where we left off yesterday. (continue from)
